name: Spond
author: John Chipps-Harding
description: Spond invitations waiting on an answer, the week you have committed to, and what you did last week

barWidget.description: Spond invitations waiting on an answer, the week you have committed to, and what you did last week

schema.label: Show a schedule for the next
schema.description: Days. Seven is a week of fixtures, which is the horizon most people actually plan against. Longer turns the panel into a season list and puts the requests further from the top.

schema.label: Look for unanswered invitations up to
schema.description: Days ahead. Wider than the schedule on purpose: a cup match six weeks out still wants an answer this week, and an invitation you cannot see is one you will forget to answer.

schema.label: Show what you did over the last
schema.description: Days. The panel's bottom section: finished events and what you answered to each. Zero turns the section off and stops the widget asking Spond for the past at all.

schema.label: Ask Spond every
schema.description: Minutes. Invitations arrive on somebody else's schedule and nothing here is urgent to the minute, so this is deliberately unhurried; opening the panel always fetches fresh regardless.

schema.label: Only this group
schema.description: A Spond group id, from `bin/spond groups`. Empty means every group the account belongs to, which is what you want unless one busy group is drowning out the rest.

schema.label: In the bar
schema.description: The default shows how many invitations are waiting on you, falling back to the time of today's next commitment when none are. 'Next commitment' always names the next thing instead, which is wider and moves the bar around it more.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: The glyph in front of the count. A football by default -- the one glyph in this font family that reads as sport without picking a sport. Change it if your bar font draws it as a box, or empty it for text alone.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units. Wide enough for a heading and a place on one line; anything wider than the screen is trimmed to fit.

schema.label: Show where
schema.description: Puts the pitch or venue beside each event. Off if your groups all play in the same place and the name is just repetition.

schema.label: Hide when there is nothing on
schema.description: Takes the widget out of the bar entirely when nothing is waiting and nothing is coming up. Off by default: a bar item that comes and goes shifts everything beside it, and a quiet icon is usually the lesser annoyance.

schema.label: Where 'Open Spond' goes
schema.description: Opened by the panel button and by a right click on the bar. The web client's home, because Spond publishes no documented deep link to a single event.
